boundary: Training label_end_date must not exceed train end; preprocessing fitted on training only. Equal weight per evaluation date, then equal weight per window.
selection: Mean Rank IC across two windows; exact ties choose simpler/earlier fixed configuration. Ranking diagnostics do not create additional tuning objectives.
unseen_evaluation: New period must be named and frozen before accessing its research data; 2022-2025 cannot be reused as unseen test. No new-period data read in round 1.
optimizer: Maximize same-date percentile score by linear programming across all signal-eligible stocks. Full investment; no turnover penalty or covariance optimization in round 1. SIC two-digit industry; unknown is separate. Missing beta/vol imputed with contemporaneous universe median; abort if column entirely missing. Infeasible/failed solve aborts, never relaxes based on performance.

execution.timing: every fifth signal date, next-close execution
execution.exceptions: existing approved OTC quote proxy and CVR exclusion unchanged

evaluation.primary: Paired change in annualized mean daily net active return versus universe EW

scope: Constraints apply to signal targets. Fees, unavailable securities, inherited positions and between-rebalance drift may change realized exposures; report execution deviations. Industry histories are effective-dated CRSP SIC, not guaranteed unrevised point-in-time releases. This is a risk-controlled observational experiment, not causal attribution.
